title: When are bond comparisons safest?
statement:
Which comparison best isolates how bond order affects bond length?

[_]{a}

explanations: Both bond types connect carbon atoms.
Changes in atom size confound the comparison.
These involve unlike elements and bonding models.

hints: Compare conventional single and multiple bonds.
Avoid mixing bonds to different elements.
solution: Hold atom identities fixed. Compare conventional single and multiple bonds. Avoid mixing bonds to different elements. Both bond types connect carbon atoms.
